title: Incorrect sensor expiry alert "time remaining"
body:
xDrip version: 2024.06.28    
Collector Dex G7
Sensor expiry shows sensor will expire in 5 hours.  But, it should say in 6 hours.  Or, it will show sensor will expire in 1 hour, but, it should show in 2 hours.  
  
The following screenshot on the left shows that the sensor will expire at 8:17 pm.
The one on the right shows the note associated with the alert, which says the sensor will expire in one hours at 6:19.  
The sensor really expired at 8:20 pm.  
So, the alert notification is incorrect by one hour.
